description:
Use this when the user wants to know what the editor offers before changing a clip: "which caption styles are
        there", "what effects can I add", "any glitch transitions", "a sound effect for a big moment", "what fonts".
        kind is one of caption_templates, fonts, caption_animations, effects, transitions, filters (color looks),
        text_styles (titles, lower thirds, subscribe buttons), text_effects (neon, gradient, 3D), text_animations,
        stickers, sounds (sound effects), music (moods), formats, shapes (output shapes), templates (the user's saved
        styles and the starters, for "edit it like last time"). query narrows by a word from
        a name or group; limit up to 300 (default 100). The names and ids it returns are what style_clip, add_to_clip
        and edit_clip take; each item has a premium flag.
        Not for: changing a clip (style_clip, add_to_clip, edit_clip), the user's own clips (list_clips) or saved
        clipping presets (list_clipping_presets). Free and read only.
name: edit_catalog
title: Edit catalog
